## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

Wave 3 (fermion-mass / Yukawa / NCG-categorical) does NOT consume Wave 2 outputs — the two waves are on orthogonal axes (M_KK-keystone/cosmology vs Yukawa/flavor). No sequencing constraint between W2 and W3. Within-session, the branching consequences of Wave 2 are:

- **MKK-RG-INVARIANCE PASS (DYNAMICAL)** → the §6.3 a(t)/Friedmann residual's M_KK-magnitude leg closes from substrate physics (Reading-B-residual survives); update the §6.3 residual to `{clock-triple (W1) only}`. Route the §6.3 reconciliation to the capstone-hygiene gate (Q1: a(t)/effective-Friedmann gap status change → housekeeping §A/§B; Q3: PROVEN/CONDITIONAL status change on the M_KK-magnitude leg).
- **MKK-RG-INVARIANCE FAIL (BARE-IMPORT)** → constructive-O3 confirmed; the §6.3 residual's M_KK-magnitude leg stays an external CONST-FREEZE-42 pin (w=M_KK borrowed). The §6.3 residual narrows to `{clock-triple (W1)}` with the M_KK-magnitude leg explicitly tagged BARE-IMPORT (a permanent boundary, not a gap to close).
- **MKK-RG-INVARIANCE INFO** → the dimensionless RG fixed-point holds but the no-import leg is HELD; route to a forward gate (derive the dimensionful M_KK anchor from a substrate-natural scale not routing through M_Pl).
- **CF3-H0-RESIDUAL INFO (expected, prior 0.70)** → the partial 6.125% relief is the honest outcome; ~94% HELD pending the one M_KK-fixing observation; the residual routes to the dimensionless-slot. NO capstone down-tag (the H₀-relief was already INFO at S110 CF3; this confirms the dimensionless-layer scope).
- **AS3a/AS3b**: AS3b PASS (NO-SHIFT) → AS3a's A_s is a POINT (verdict-A); AS3b FAIL (SHIFT) → A_s is a BAND (verdict-B). EITHER WAY, AS3a lands one defensible A_s with the SCHEME-DEPENDENT-for-magnitude + FI/PERMANENT-floor sub-annotation. Canonical write-order: AS3a verdict → canonical_constants (A_s_FW + POINT/BAND sub-key) → mack writes falsifier Row 8.
- **VIICE-NW PASS (THEOREM)** → §VII.CE clause-(a) basis upgrades author-stipulated → substrate-derived (an annotation on the STAGE-3-PERMANENT entry; the Stage-2 PASS-AND stands). **VIICE-NW FAIL (CONTRADICTION)** → flags the (n₁−n₂)↔(w₁−w₂) READING for re-examination (the perfect-square FORM + sign stand; the identification is questioned) — route to capstone-hygiene Q3.

**Capstone-hygiene gate (5-question) routing for Wave 2** (per `.claude/rules/capstone-hygiene-gate.md`): Q1 fires iff MKK-RG-INVARIANCE alters the §6.3 a(t)/effective-Friedmann gap status (PASS or FAIL both alter it — PASS closes the M_KK-magnitude leg, FAIL pins it BARE-IMPORT); Q3 fires iff any of {MKK-RG, VIICE-NW} changes a PROVEN/CONDITIONAL/INFO status; route YES answers to `sessions/session-111/session-111-housekeeping.md` §A (in-session designated-writer fix) or §B (compute carry-forward). The §6.3 / §VII.CE / falsifier-Row-8 prose reconciliations land via the designated writers (capstone prose owner for §6.3; mack-cosmic-bridge for the falsifier-Row-8 / §7 surface).
